notes: NEW MODE: BAGGED UP (kill confirmed). Everyone drops their stash bag when they die - grab enemy bags to score (BAGGED, +100), grab your own team's to stop them scoring (STASH SAVED, +50). Offline with bots and ONLINE.

NEW MODE: TURF WAR (domination). Three grow spots, A, B and C, each a weed plant under a grow lamp. Stand in one to take it (faster with more of you); every spot your team holds scores. Offline with bots and ONLINE, and both new modes are in private matches.
KILLCAM: when you die you now see it over your killer's shoulder first - their name, their gun, the distance, and a marker where you went down. Turn it off in Settings (KILLCAM).

4 NEW SCORESTREAKS: DEALER DRONE (a drone flies a very loud package to the nearest enemy), SMOKE OUT (counter-UAV: jams the enemy radar and spy planes for 30 s and makes their aim hazy), TRAP HOUSE TURRET (a sentry gun guards your spot for 30 s) and HIGH FLYER (a gunship circles the map shelling enemies for 22 s). Pick them in SCORESTREAKS.
